summary: Deninu School is a K-12 public school in Fort Resolution, Northwest Territories, Canada. It is the only public education option for youth in the hamlet and serves about 125 students. The school is administered by the South Slave Divisional Education Council (SSDEC).
one_line: Deninu School is the K-12 public school in Fort Resolution, Northwest Territories, serving about 125 students under the South Slave Divisional Education Council.
key_facts: Deninu School is a K-12 public school located in Fort Resolution, Northwest Territories, Canada.
Deninu School is the only public education option for youth in the hamlet of Fort Resolution.
Deninu School serves a student population of approximately 125 students.
The administration of Deninu School is the responsibility of the South Slave Divisional Education Council (SSDEC).
